αἰνὴν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome; fem. acc. sg.
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after εἰ γάρ: εἰ γὰρ … ἔρις γένοιτο ’if only a contest might arise’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it come to be’ (μὴ … ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο ’lest the matter become public’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’it would be’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would become’ (ἡμῖν δ’ ἂν ἐλέγχεα ταῦτα γένοιτο ’and to us these would become reproaches’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after a hortatory subj., no particle: ’let it arise, may it come about’ (βοὴ δ’ ὤκιστα γένοιτο ’and let a cry go up quickly’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a bare wish: ’so may it be’ (καὶ νῦν ὧδε γένοιτο ’so may it be now’)
δαπέδῳ: δάπεδον — level ground, floor, pavement; neut. dat. sg. (τυκτῷ δαπέδῳ ’on the wrought, levelled floor’)
δεπάεσσι: δέπας — cup, goblet; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δέπασι)
δοιαὶ: δοιός — two, twofold; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic δύο, διττοί)
δῶκα: δίδωμι — give; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκα)
εἰσορόωντες: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze on; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντες)
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without ν-movable
εὐρυάγυια: εὐρυάγυιος — with broad streets; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., agreeing with πτόλις
θανέεσθαι: θνῄσκω — die; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖσθαι): ’to die’
θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
θεῖναι: τίθημι — put, set, make; aor. inf. act., explaining ἄριστα: ’(best) to make, to set up (a stone)’
καθήμενοι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
κερτομίοις: κερτόμιος — taunting, cutting, mocking; neut. dat. pl.
κῆρας: κήρ — doom, fate of death, death-spirit; fem. acc. pl.
κῆρι: κῆρ — heart; neut. dat. sg., in the fixed adverbial idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περί used adverbially)
μεγαίρω: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge, be unwilling to allow; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I do not grudge [them] to’ · also with no complement, οὔ τι μεγαίρω: ’I grudge [it] not at all’
μεμαυῖαν: μάω (perf. μέμαα) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’eager, clamouring’
μεμαὼς: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic, with present sense (no Attic equivalent): ’straining, eager’
μενεαίνεις: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on (doing); pres. 2 sg., epic, + inf.: ’you are eager’
μυκήνη: Μυκήνη — Mycene, eponymous heroine of the city; nom. sg.
ναιετάουσι: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι); of a place, ’are inhabited’
παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg.
πλησίαι: πλήσιος — near, close; fem. nom. pl., + gen.: ’close to one another’ (πλησίαι ἀλλήλων)
πόληες: πόλις — city; fem. nom. pl., epic -ηες (= Attic -εις)
στρατῷ: στρατός — army, host; masc. dat. sg.
τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): ’of these/those women’ · also fem. gen. pl., partitive, of things just named: ’of these’ (τάων ἥν κ’ ἐθέλῃσιν ’whichever of these he wishes’) · also relative, fem. gen. pl., with the nouns that follow: ’of whom’ (τάων … λώβην τε καὶ αἴσχεα ’whose outrage and shames’)
τίθησι: τίθημι — put, set, lay upon; pres. 3 sg.
ταὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they’ · also fem. nom. pl. in a command to the maids, ’you others’ (ταὶ δὲ … ἔρχεσθε) · also with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ταὶ δὲ γυναῖκες ’and the women’)
τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’ · also accented before enclitic τί (τοῦτό τί μοι ’this, I think’) · also accented before enclitic τοι: ’this, for you’
φθονέω: φθονέω — begrudge, grudge (+ gen. of the thing); pres. 1 sg.
φραζώμεθ: φράζομαι — think out, devise, plan; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortative, elided (φραζώμεθ’ = φραζώμεθα) ’let us plan’
φύλοπιν: φύλοπις — battle-din, battle; fem. acc. sg.
χρυσέοις: χρύσεος — golden; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῖς)
ἀγορεύων: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell, recount; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’telling’
ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg. · also the city Athens: εὐρυάγυιαν Ἀθήνην ’wide-streeted Athens’
ἀθηναίῃ: Ἀθηναίη — Athena, epic full form (= Ἀθήνη); fem. dat. sg.
ἀργείη: Ἀργεῖος — Argive; adj., fem. nom. sg.
ἀσπερχὲς: ἀσπερχής — without pause, vehement; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
ἀτέλεστον: ἀτέλεστος — unfulfilled, without result, endless; neut. acc. sg.
ἄγριος: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. sg.
ἅλιον: Ἅλιος — Halius (’Sea-man’), a Phaeacian youth; masc. acc. sg.
ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’ · also dat. sg. after ὑπό: ’under me’ · also dat. of possession: ’my’ (ἐμοί γ’ ὄνομ’ ἐστίν ’my name is’)
ἐρεθιζέμεν: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, rouse; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic -ειν): ’to provoke’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’) · also relative, ’from which, whence’ (ἔνθεν ἔπινον ’from which they drank’)
ἥβη: ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. nom. sg. (Ionic η for α)
ἥσθην: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 dual: ’the two sat’
ἵενται: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. dart, rush; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’dart’
ὀϊόμενον: ὀΐομαι — expect, suppose; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οἰόμενον)
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’urge on’
ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized’
